mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_product_review (order_id, product_id, member_id, score, content, images, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{memberId}, #{score}, #{content}, #{images}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, r.order_id, r.product_id, r.member_id, r.score, r.content, r.images, r.create_time, m.nick_name AS member_nickname, m.avatar_url AS member_avatar, p.name AS product_name FROM mall_product_review r LEFT JOIN mall_member m ON m.member_id = r.member_id LEFT JOIN mall_product p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
SELECT product_id FROM mall_product_review WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mall_product_review WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND product_id = #{productId}
